headline: Soledad launches new free after-school arts program for youth from state grant.
summary: The Soledad City Council unanimously approved Wednesday Oct. 7, by 5-0, the acceptance of a $16,862 grant from the California Arts Council's Arts and Youth Program to implement a new free after-school arts program for children ages 6 to 10.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
imageCredit: Image: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
